Class Node

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Numbered
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Node
All Implemented Interfaces:
Commented, Comparable<Node>
public class Node extends Numbered implements Comparable<Node>, Commented
A node represents a specific moment in a story graph; it defines a value for every fluent, a numeric utility value for the story and each character, possible futures represented by its temporal edges, and the beliefs of each character represented by its epistemic edges.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware
